Add actorControl configuration to each bot profile

Release held Type 2 emotes after speech when requested

maintenance.rule: When an item is completed, record the result in project-status.json, update this roadmap, refresh repository-checks.json, and add a concise CHANGELOG.md entry.
maintenance.checkout_rule: Use npm ci, then run npm run status:check after fetching and before beginning the next work item.
maintenance.security: Never place live credentials, authenticated OBS addresses, capability request authorization values, or private certificate material in roadmap files.
